name: Minto Mitsurugi
source:
She is the May-Droid, Maya Android. Maya is the goddess of growth. She is like a child, as she does not know much about the world, even though she has large database of information to rely on when she doesn't know what word like ''Lolicon'' means.

[Taken from [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/console/dreamcast/review/R23645.html]GameFAQs review[/url].]
